orderid: No FHIR element independently serializes mimiciv_icu.inputevents.orderid. The authoritative ICU MedicationAdministration projection found no populated MedicationAdministration.identifier, request, or request.identifier.value, and the ICU ETL uses orderid only inside the opaque resource UUID (mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_administration_icu.sql:20,40-60). Resource ids are join-only and cannot be parsed or inverted. The shape-preserving candidate therefore emits CAST(NULL AS INTEGER). The remaining clinical row grain is represented by stay_id, starttime, and endtime: the full-oracle measurement recorded 14,174 distinct (stay_id, starttime, endtime) rows, while orderid is an administrative identity and the manifest's orderid key is comparison metadata.
